links.targetTitle: BD planning — industry and companion-software selection (20 Aug 2026)

title: Manufacturing is the only industry assessed as satisfying every criterion
content:
Manufacturing is recorded as sufficiently decentralized with standardization — "many factories are SMEs", with "standardised procurement and delivery: PPEP" — able to help establish PMF, holding companion software in UMH and Paperless, "well connected", and possessing an established consultancy market evidenced by the Industry Dynamics proposal to NIKO.

Every other industry assessed carries at least one miss or question mark. Manufacturing carries none, and it is also the industry whose companion software (Paperless) the session then took forward into a worked demo scenario.

That coherence — criteria satisfied, relationships in place, a named consultancy engagement, and a demo already storyboarded — is what makes it the default first target rather than one option among several.
description: Decentralized into SME factories with standardized procurement, companion software in UMH and Paperless, well connected, and with a live consultancy example in the Industry Dynamics proposal to NIKO.
